<!-- pr-reviewer: 85076f40f3567f0525293aaa48b4b280bb41b373 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** I tried to break the "moved unchanged" claim and could not.

**What I checked**
- **The moved bodies are identical.** I took `core_spiral` and `orbit` from base `a6bd69d8` `adaptive/mod.rs` and from `adaptive/core.rs` at the head, stripped indentation and the two `pub(super)` markers, and diffed them: 76 lines each, no difference with whitespace ignored.
- **Every free name resolves to the same item as before.** No glob import is used, so nothing can quietly bind a different item. `rotate_to`/`tail` -> `front.rs`, `circle` -> `rings.rs`, `orbit_radius` -> `star.rs` (the parent still imports it for its own use), `loops::cleared_loops`, `spiral::revolution` (not `morph`'s same-named method, because the path is explicit), `MAX_ROUNDS` = 3000 and `SPIRAL_STEPS` (11 entries) stay in the parent and are imported by path. `SpiralTrial` and `SPIRAL_FRONT = 0.6` moved verbatim, and nothing else used them. `Point2` is `crate::geo2d::Point2` on both sides. The new private `mod core` does not shadow anything, because no file in `adaptive/` uses a `core::` path.
- **`lift.rs`: only doc comments changed.** In `git diff -w`, every `+`/`-` line is a `///` line. The text still says the same things (MICROLIFT, CRUMBS, Travel).
- **File sizes and provenance.** The new module has a provenance line (Stori & Wright 2000; Held & Spielberger 2009). Line counts: `mod.rs` 344, `core.rs` 98, `lift.rs` 400.

**Local results (trial merge with origin/main `23c62044`, clean, Windows)**
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib adaptive` | 24 passed, 1 ignored |
| motion `adaptive_band` / `adaptive_hsm` / `adaptive_orbit_seam` / `pocket3d_hsm` | 2 / 1 (5 ign) / 1 / 3 (1 ign) passed |
| `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test pocket3d_hsm -- --ignored` (heavy lane, exact output pin 16197 / 15458 / 1581) | 1 passed (202 s) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test golden_cl` | 25 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The heavy lane above is the exact per-platform output pin for the adaptive planner. Your PR body lists it as not exercised; it has now been run on Windows and holds.
- Process: conventional subject, `Changelog: none` (fine for a behaviour-neutral refactor), `Fixes #851`, decision file in `docs/decisions/`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: 85076f40f3567f0525293aaa48b4b280bb41b373 -->
**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$0.39 known (69k tokens known)
| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| author's own session review | - | not known | not known |
| high-tier review (half of a 138k two-PR run) | Opus 5.5 | 69k | ~$0.39 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.
